text: 아이템에 반납 예정일 개념을 넣고, 예정일 하루 전에 소유자에게 리마인더 이메일을 보내는 Celery periodic task를 추가해줘. 지금 backend에는 Celery가 없으니까 backend/pyproject.toml에 celery 의존성을 추가하고, 태스크는 새 파일 backend/app/tasks.py에 넣어줘. backend/app/models.py의 Item 모델에 due_date랑 reminder_sent_at 필드를 새로 추가하고 Alembic 마이그레이션도 backend/app/alembic/versions/에 만들어줘. 이미 보낸 건 reminder_sent_at으로 중복 발송 막아주면 돼. 메일은 app/utils.py에 있는 이메일 본문 렌더링 함수와 send_email을 쓰고, 템플릿은 backend/app/email-templates/item_due_reminder.html로 새로 만들어줘.

This app has no Dockerfile yet, so add one at the repo root. Work this way: write the Dockerfile so package.json and the existing package-lock.json are copied before `npm ci`, with a BuildKit cache mount for /root/.npm, and only copy the rest of the source after the install so code changes don't bust the dependency layer. Add a .dockerignore for node_modules and .next. Keep the container's entry point the same as the `start` script in package.json so a plain `docker run -p 3000:3000 <image>` serves the app.

text: We have duplicate rows in the item table where the same owner saved the same title more than once. Write a dedupe step in a new module backend/app/dedupe_items.py (runnable like backend/app/initial_data.py) that keeps the earliest row per (owner_id, title) by Item.created_at and deletes the rest. Use SQLModel/SQLAlchemy through the existing engine in app/core/db.py, which we already depend on, and don't add any new packages. Also print a before/after count per day of created_at so I can sanity check it against the database directly.

Add a pre-start check to the backend: in backend/app/core/db.py, add a function that compares the database's current Alembic revision with the head revision in backend/app/alembic/versions and raises to abort startup if they don't match, then call it from init() in backend/app/initial_data.py before init_db runs. Minimal diff please: one new function and one call inside `init()`.
